subject: gk
question: Which offence, as per the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, is punishable with a minimum imprisonment of 3 years, extendable up to 10 years, along with fine, and is triable by a Magistrate of the First Class ?

options.text: Hiring or engaging a child to commit an offence

solution:
The correct answer is __**Hiring or engaging a child to commit an offence**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Under the **Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023**, hiring or engaging a child to commit an offence is considered a serious crime.
 
• This offence is punishable with a **minimum imprisonment of 3 years**, extendable up to **10 years**, along with a fine.
